M/s Saroj Treelinks through its Partner
 Jay Prakash Singhania, Ranchi ...

Respondents
 -----
Coram: Hon'Ble Mr. Justice Sanjay Kumar Dwivedi
-----
For the Petitioner : Mr. Sumeet Gadodia, Advocate For Respondent Nos. 1 & 2 : Mr. Deepankar Roy,
A.C. to A.G.
-----
02/13.12.2021.
Heard Mr. Sumeet Gadodia, learned counsel for the petitioner and Mr. Deepankar Roy, learned counsel for respondent nos. 1 and 2.
Mr. Sumeet Gadodia, learned counsel for the petitioner undertakes to remove surviving defects within a week.

Learned counsel for the petitioner submits that after issuance of Project Approval in favour of the petitioner firm, the National Horticulture Board also granted clearance on 18.03.2021 for availing term loan from Bank to start implementation of the project work as per the terms and conditions stipulated in IPA letter dated 17.11.2020 and also gave in principle approval to the subsidy claims.

He further submits that even the petitioner has obtained license under the provision of the Food,
Safety and Standard Authority of India Act, 2006.

sentences.text: He further submits that the petitioner has also installed 4 water harvesting systems in the Mushroom cultivation plant at Nagri.

He also submits that environment clearance is not required, which has been communicated by the ICAR- Directorate of Mushroom Research, Indian Council of Agricultural Research, Chambaghat, Solan, Himachal Pradesh vide letter dated 30.10.2021.

entities.text: Indian Council of Agricultural Research, Chambaghat
entities.label: ORG

sentences.text: He further submits that without issuing any notice to the petitioner, the impugned order has been passed.
Mr. Deepankar Roy, learned counsel for opposite party nos. 1 and 2 is directed to file counter affidavit.

opennyai_summary.arguments:
Learned counsel for the petitioner submits that after issuance of Project Approval in favour of the petitioner firm, the National Horticulture Board also granted clearance on 18.03.2021 for availing term loan from Bank to start implementation of the project work as per the terms and conditions stipulated in IPA letter dated 17.11.2020 and also gave in principle approval to the subsidy claims.
He further submits that even the petitioner has obtained license under the provision of the Food,
Safety and Standard Authority of India Act, 2006.
He further submits that the petitioner has also installed 4 water harvesting systems in the Mushroom cultivation plant at Nagri.
He also submits that environment clearance is not required, which has been communicated by the ICAR- Directorate of Mushroom Research, Indian Council of Agricultural Research, Chambaghat, Solan, Himachal Pradesh vide letter dated 30.10.2021.
Mr. Deepankar Roy, learned counsel for opposite party nos. 1 and 2 is directed to file counter affidavit.
